description: This file defines a React component named EditorPage which serves as the main page for creating or editing a blog post. It manages local state for the post title and content, provides UI elements such as an input for the title, a custom rich text editor component, and a save button. It also handles image uploads via an imported utility. The component supports both creating a new post and editing an existing one based on URL parameters.

methods.name: EditorPage
methods.description: React functional component for the post editor page, supporting create/edit modes, handling state, and rendering editor UI.
